description.narrative: A strategic decision has been made by Cordaid in 2023 to evolve the thematic area at that time of Sustainable Livelihoods (SL) and Resilience towards Sustainable Agri-Food Systems (SAFS) with gender, climate and locally-led development, amongst others, as cross-cutting themes. The focus on system strengthening allows Cordaid to work on structural changes and address constraints for sustainable impact for our target communities at scale. However, this focus on agri-food system strengthening has yet not been embedded in our overall SAFS programming across the Country Offices. The Cordaid’s SAFS team aims to “unlock” the knowledge and learnings from the main ongoing and past SAFS related projects and programs. Cordaid has a considerable track-record on Market Systems Development (MSD), Value Chain Development (VCD), Access to Finance (A2F) and Public-Private Partnerships (PPPs) that could be better used for organisational learning and the development of evidence-based models and solutions. As such the Cordaid’s SAFS team aims to strengthen Cordaid’s positioning, project acquisition and internal capacities on using Food Systems (FS) as a conceptual or analytical framework.

✓ Strengthen Cordaid’s internal knowledge base on key SAFS related issues and solutions ✓ Develop an evidence base to improve Cordaid’s positioning in SAFS ✓ Improve Cordaid’s agri-food system’s assessment methodology to identify viable, sustainable and impactful projects at scale and strengthen SAFS programming ✓ Strengthen Cordaid’s internal capacities on food systems strengthening
